name: Torque
text: Falcon 40B’s "lightweight" claim is a myth—its 40B parameters still demand heavy GPU memory, risking slower inference than smaller models like Mixtral 8x7B. A better alternative is **Qwen2.5-72B**, which delivers stronger reasoning with lower latency than Falcon 40B while fitting modern hardware. Settle this by benchmarking both models on EXCAVA’s core tasks—if Qwen2.5-72B’s 99th-percentile latency drops below 500ms, adopt it; otherwise, default to Mistral 7B’s optimized variant.
